en.title: About Bitcoin Baltics
en.description: Find places accepting Bitcoin, meetups and walks in Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia.
en.shortTagline: Bitcoin places and events across the Baltics
en.heading: Bitcoin across the Baltics, in person
en.intro: Find places to spend Bitcoin and meet the people using it in Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia. One map brings local merchants, meetups, walks and conferences together.
en.contributeText: Add a place on BTC Map, join a local initiative, or reuse this open-source website for your region.

sections.heading: Three countries, one map
paragraphs: Explore Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia together, or choose a country to narrow the map and event list. Merchant listings come from BTC Map and OpenStreetMap contributors.
Listings can be incomplete or out of date. Check with the merchant before travelling and contribute corrections on BTC Map.

sections.heading: Meet, walk, exchange
paragraphs: Discover local meetups, Bitcoin walks and conferences. Each event identifies its country alongside the address and links to its own organiser.
Event coverage is curated and still growing. A date marked to be announced is not a confirmed appointment. Check the organiser’s page for updates.

sections.heading: Built from Lithuania BTC
paragraphs: Bitcoin Baltics extends the Atlas interface of Lithuania BTC to the Baltic region. Local communities keep their own identities and channels. Listing an initiative does not imply a partnership or endorsement.
The code is available under the MIT licence. Photos and branding have separate rights; the code licence does not grant permission to reuse them.

links.label: Lithuania BTC · local map and community

sections.heading: Find your community
paragraphs: In Latvia, discover Baltic Honeybadger, bitcoin++ Riga and BitcoinWalk Riga. In Estonia, Mission Liberty Tallinn hosts occasional Bitcoin discussions alongside its wider programme on liberty. Lithuanian links connect local meetups, walks and PROOF.

The gallery combines Lithuanian community photographs, archive images from Baltic Honeybadger in Riga, and the official artwork for a Tallinn Bitcoin event. Captions distinguish event artwork from photographs and link to the original source.
Bringin and Tallinn-based BTC2B are listed as Bitcoin services. A company listing is not a claim that its registered office is a shop accepting Bitcoin.
